Package models.users

Class User

java.lang.Object
models.users.User
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Employee, ResearcherDecorator, Student
public abstract class User extends Object implements Serializable
Abstract base class for all users in the university system. Passwords are stored as SHA-256 hashes — never in plain text. Implements Serializable for database persistence.

  • Constructor Details

    • User

      public User(String id, String name, String email, String password, Language language)
      Creates a new user. The password is hashed with SHA-256 before storing.
      Parameters:
      id - unique user ID
      name - full name
      email - email address used for login
      password - plain text password — hashed immediately, never stored as-is
      language - preferred language

    • User

      protected User(String id, String name, String email, String password, Language language, boolean alreadyHashed)
      Constructor for cases where the password is already hashed. Used by ResearcherDecorator to avoid double-hashing.
      Parameters:
      id - unique user ID
      name - full name
      email - email address
      password - value to store as password field
      language - preferred language
      alreadyHashed - if true, password is stored as-is without hashing
